title: Nintendo Wii Remote Controller Black RVL-003 OEM Official with Wrist Strap
categoryName: Video Games & Consoles:Video Game Accessories:Controllers & Attachments
conditionDescription: Pre-owned, untested. Scuffs and a light gray mark on the battery cover, normal surface wear. Some residue on the battery contacts and screws (pictured). Wrist strap included. No batteries.
descriptionText:
Official Nintendo Wii Remote (Wiimote), model RVL-003, in black, with the original Nintendo wrist strap.

- Genuine Nintendo OEM, not a third-party copy
- Works with Nintendo Wii and Wii U
- Standard Wii Remote (no Motion Plus built in)

Condition: pre-owned and untested. Front is clean with light wear. The battery cover has scuffs and a light gray mark (close-up pictured). There is some residue/discoloration on the battery contacts and screws inside the compartment (pictured). Battery cover included; batteries not included.

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
